questionText:
Dr. Aris: Have you had a chance to review the latest clinical trial data for the new immunotherapy drug?
Dr. Miller: Yes, I read through the entire report yesterday evening. The efficacy rates against melanoma are truly remarkable.
Dr. Aris: ----
Dr. Miller: That's precisely my concern as well. Over thirty percent of participants reported acute liver inflammation, which cannot be overlooked.

options.A: Indeed, but did you notice the alarming frequency of adverse hepatic side effects?
options.B: Do you think the pharmaceutical manufacturer will reduce the market price once it is approved?
options.C: I disagree completely; the sample size of eighty patients was far too small to draw conclusions.
options.D: Why didn't the regulatory authorities mandate a double-blind trial before granting authorization?
options.E: The patients must have felt tremendous relief when their tumours began shrinking so rapidly.
